angle: Frame 0: an emoji keyboard with a blank slot + hook. Viewer checks their phone: there isn't one. Twist: chatbots insist there is, then spit out a fish, a horse, and spiral. Why: the model builds 'seahorse + emoji' internally, but no such token exists, so it picks the nearest one, sees the wrong emoji, and tries again. Loop: 'So... is there a seahorse emoji?'
strengths: Frame-0 puzzle the viewer can answer or check (week-3 brief rule); loopable ending
weaknesses: Meme peaked Oct 2025; our angle is the mechanism, which competitors skip.
